description:
Why Join Us? 
 
 This is an exciting opportunity to shape the future of communications and digital engagement within a leading institution. The Web Developer Supervisor will play a vital role in enhancing the user experience through innovative technologies, strategic communication, and user-centered solutions.
 
 The university is committed to fostering a workplace where employees are valued, empowered, and encouraged to contribute their ideas, creativity, and expertise.
 
 The University of Southern California (USC) is seeking an innovative and collaborative Web Developer Supervisor to lead digital communications and customer experience initiatives across the institution. This role is responsible for overseeing how information is communicated through web and digital technologies while partnering with university leaders to develop strategies that enhance engagement, accessibility, and the user experience.
 
 The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise with strategic communication skills and a passion for human-centered design. This leader will guide cross-functional teams, manage digital communication initiatives, and champion technology solutions that improve how audiences access information and interact with university resources.
 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Develop and implement engagement and digital communication strategies aligned with university goals and culture.

 Lead customer and user experience initiatives focused on accessibility, usability, and effective communication delivery.

 Oversee web and digital communication platforms, ensuring high-quality content, functionality, and user engagement.

 Collaborate with university leaders and stakeholders to develop customer experience visions and communication strategies.

 Gather and analyze audience interaction and engagement data to improve communication effectiveness and digital experiences.

 Develop segmentation strategies and user personas to better understand and serve university audiences.

 Establish communication governance standards, procedures, quality controls, and performance metrics.

 Drive innovation in digital communications by introducing new technologies, tools, and communication approaches.

 Supervise staff and/or student workers, providing coaching, performance management, and professional development.

 Manage multiple concurrent projects, timelines, and organizational priorities effectively.

 Support continuous improvement of communication systems, workflows, and digital platforms.

 Promote a collaborative and inclusive workplace culture aligned with university values and ethics.

 
 Preferred Qualifications: 
 Master’s degree in a related field preferred

 10+ years of relevant professional experience

 4+ years of management or leadership experience

 
 Preferred Knowledge, Skills & Abilities: 
 Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills

 Experience developing customer experience strategies and customer-facing applications

 Knowledge of human-centered design and user experience best practices

 Proven project management and organizational skills

 Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment

 Strategic thinking and executive-level collaboration skills

 Experience working within large, complex organizations

 Knowledge of communication governance, policies, and compliance standards

 Experience with content management systems (CMS), SEO, and usability engineering

 Familiarity with front-end and back-end website development

 Experience with object-oriented design, servers, and programming languages

 Knowledge of graphic design and photo editing tools such as Canva and Photoshop

 Ability to lead and develop high-performing, cross-functional teams

 Experience in higher education or human resources environments preferred

 
 Minimum Qualifications:  
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Public Relations, Business Administration, Marketing, Or a related field

 Minimum of 7 years of experience in Marketing, Communications, User/customer experience

 Minimum of 1 year of management experience with direct staff coaching and supervision

 
 Combined education and relevant experience may substitute for minimum education requirements. 
 
 Application Process: 
 
 Interested candidates should submit the following materials:
 Cover Letter

 Resume or Curriculum Vitae

 Portfolio or examples of web development and digital communication projects

 
 Join us in creating innovative digital experiences that connect, engage, and empower our university community.
 
 The annual base salary target for this position is $117,654. When extending an offer of employment, the University of Southern California considers factors such as (but not limited to) the scope and responsibilities of the position, the candidate’s work experience, education/training, key skills, internal peer alignment, federal, state, and local laws, contractual stipulations, grant funding, as well as external market and organizational considerations.
 
 #LI-Hybrid
 
 
Minimum Education: Bachelor's degree In Computer Science Or Public Relations Or Business Administration Or Marketing Or in related field(s) 

Addtional Education Requirements Combined experience/education as substitute for minimum education 
Minimum Experience: 7 years in marketing/communications and user/customer experience. And 1 year in a management role, providing frequent, regular performance coaching. 

Minimum Skills: Excellent written and oral communication skills, able to synthesize complex materials and craft creative, persuasive messaging for varied audiences. Experience developing customer experience strategies and implementing customer-facing applications. Demonstrated knowledge of human-centered design and user/customer experience best practices. Proven project management and organizational skills, able to manage several projects and deadlines simultaneously. Ability to think strategically and serve as a thought-partner to teams of executives. Experience supporting customer needs and articulating strategies that motivate others to action. Proven ability to understand and work with large, complex systems, and comply with and enforce pertinent policies, procedures, regulations, and requirements. Ability to manage necessary resources to resolve problems in a timely and effective manner. 
Preferred Education: Master's degree In Computer Science Or Public Relations Or Business Administration Or Marketing Or in related field(s) 

Preferred Experience: 10 years in marketing/communications and user/customer experience. And 4 years in a management role. 
Preferred Skills: Experience in human resources and/or higher education. Proven experience in change management governance processes and development. Demonstrated experience developing and managing heterogeneous, high-performing teams. Experience developing customer relationships and delivering customer-focused service. Proven experience with object-oriented design, servers and programming languages. Demonstrated experience with content management systems, applications, search engine optimization (SEO) and usability engineering. Experience with email distribution lists, graphic design and photo editing tools (e.g., Canvas, Photoshop). Experience with front- and back-end website design. 
                                                    
 
 USC is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law or USC policy. USC observes affirmative action obligations consistent with state and federal law. USC will consider for employment all qualified applicants with criminal records in a manner consistent with applicable laws and regulations, including the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for employers and the Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, and with due consideration for patient and student safety. Please refer to the   Background Screening Policy Appendix D   for specific employment screen implications for the position for which you are applying.  
 
 We provide reasonable accommodations to applicants and employees with disabilities. Applicants with questions about access or requiring a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application or hiring process should contact USC Human Resources by phone at (213) 821-8100, or by email at  uschr@usc.edu . Inquiries will be treated as confidential to the extent permitted by law.
